Title: Azure Arc enabled PostgreSQL Hyperscale now in preview

Body.Content:
Azure Arc enabled PostgreSQL Hyperscale is now in preview as part of Azure Arc enabled data services, providing you with elastic scale, automation, and a unified hybrid management experience for Azure Database for PostgreSQL Hyperscale data workloads operating on any infrastructure with or without a direct connection to the cloud.

Azure Arc enabled PostgreSQL Hyperscale is the same technology that is available on Azure as a PaaS service deployment option and expands the boundaries of Azure Database for PostgreSQL Hyperscale to any infrastructure beyond Microsoft Azure. Azure Arc enabled PostgreSQL Hyperscale can be deployed and managed on-premises, on the edge, or on multi-cloud environments using Kubernetes with the infrastructure of your choice.
